# AltTabio

> AltTabio is a free, open-source Alt+Tab replacement and window switcher for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and a Cmd+Tab replacement for macOS 26 and later. On Windows it shows a list of open windows with optional number labels, a live preview of the selected window, and an editable search query. On macOS it lists the running apps and every window of the selected one, minimized windows and windows on other Spaces included. No ads, no account, no telemetry. Release builds on both platforms contact GitHub to check for and download updates. Automatic updates can be turned off in Settings; manual checks remain available.

AltTabio is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Microsoft, Apple, or Alt+Tab Terminator.

## Product

- [Product page](https://vibeslop.github.io/AltTabio/): Landing page for both platforms with a switcher demo to try, the install command, and FAQ
- [Docs](https://vibeslop.github.io/AltTabio/docs/): Install, verification, shortcuts, settings, permissions, updates, and uninstall steps for Windows and Mac, with a comparison to the built-in Alt+Tab and Cmd+Tab
- [Product notes (Markdown)](https://vibeslop.github.io/AltTabio/product.md): Facts for search engines and language models
- [Full description](https://vibeslop.github.io/AltTabio/llms-full.txt): Complete product description for AI systems

## Download and source

- [Latest release for Windows and macOS](https://github.com/vibeslop/AltTabio/releases/latest)
- [macOS install command](https://github.com/vibeslop/AltTabio#macos): run `curl -fsSL https://vibeslop.github.io/AltTabio/install.sh | sh` in Terminal; it runs the installer only if it is signed with the pinned release certificate
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/vibeslop/AltTabio)
- [MIT License](https://github.com/vibeslop/AltTabio/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [Issues and help](https://github.com/vibeslop/AltTabio/issues)
